caption: This is my #runlikeamother  For context this happened over a year ago. My mother and I were in the kitchen with my youngest son. He was eating in his high chair and started to choke on his food. I realized what was happening and screamed for my mom. My mom rushed over and helped me flip my son over so I could preform the baby Heimlich. My husband was in the living room watching our eldest son and our dog. My husband heard me screaming and immediately ran to my aid confused and terrified. My husband has PTSD from the military. You can see the panic and relief on his face and body language after everything was over. Immediately after this video ended my husband came into the kitchen to comfort me and our son. My mother, my husband, my eldest son and even the dog ran to me as soon as I screamed.
